A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we provide an SDN-based flow rerouting mechanism, which allows the VNFs to be stateless.
SHarP is an SDN-based, stateless, and loss-less flow migration solution that is not tied to a specific state management mechanism and is scalable.

state management and flow handover can be decoupled, which is beneficial for both, VNF vendors as well as SDN controllers.
